toyota_summary:
The EU is moving to tighten supply chains for composite materials used in vehicle manufacturing. The European Commission launched an investigation into resin and glass fiber imports that could result in new trade restrictions. This matters because automakers across Europe rely on these materials for lightweight parts, particularly in EV production, and import tariffs would increase costs at a moment when margins are already under pressure from the EV transition.

Meanwhile, the U.S. remains an outlier on EV adoption. While EV sales are surging globally, the Trump administration has scrapped purchase subsidies, leaving American automakers struggling to compete on price with Chinese rivals. The risk is real: without incentives, U.S. consumers will continue to favor cheaper imports, forcing domestic manufacturers to cut prices and accept lower profits.

Watch whether the Irish presidency's proposal to let automakers bank unused emissions credits becomes EU law—it would give manufacturers breathing room to meet 2025 targets but could also delay the pace of electrification.

emails.subject_en: ‘Cleaning our clock’: EVs are booming everywhere — except the US
emails.summary_en: Electric vehicle sales are surging worldwide—now a third of all car sales globally, per the IEA—while the U.S. lags at just 6% after the Trump administration scrapped Biden-era EV tax credits. Countries like Germany, Vietnam and Australia are posting much higher EV adoption rates, often backed by subsidies, leaving American automakers and consumers increasingly out of step with the global shift. The divergence is also fueling geopolitical tension, as nations weigh EV incentives against concerns over China's dominance in battery and vehicle manufacturing.

emails.subject_en: Car drama at the EU-UK summit
emails.summary_en: At today's EU-UK summit in Brussels, UK and EU leaders will discuss whether Britain can secure 'Made in Europe' status under the EU's Industrial Accelerator Act, a critical issue since roughly 60% of UK auto exports go to the EU. Brussels is wary that granting this status could let Chinese automakers use the UK to bypass EU tariffs, especially as Chinese brands already account for one in three EVs sold in Britain.
emails.summary_ja: 本日ブリュッセルで開催されるEU・英国サミットでは、英国がEUの産業加速化法(IAA)の下で「Made in Europe」の地位を獲得できるかが焦点となる。英国の自動車輸出の約6割がEU向けであるため、この問題は業界にとって極めて重要だ。EU側は、この地位付与が中国メーカーによる英国を経由した関税回避につながることを懸念しており、既に英国で販売されるEVの3台に1台が中国製となっている。

emails.summary_en: Honda will invest an additional $460 million in its Alabama plant to meet growing demand for hybrid vehicles in the U.S. market. Separately, South Korean auto parts makers are stepping up investments in southern India, underscoring deepening Korea-India automotive supply chain ties. Meanwhile, a U.S. House committee has opened an inquiry into Mercedes-Benz's business ties with China, adding scrutiny to global automakers' China exposure.
emails.summary_ja: ホンダは米国でのハイブリッド車需要拡大に対応するため、アラバマ工場に4億6000万ドルを追加投資する。一方、韓国系自動車関連メーカーは南インドで投資を相次いで発表しており、韓印の自動車サプライチェーン連携が深まっている。また、米下院の対中特別委員会はメルセデス・ベンツの対中関係について調査を開始し、自動車メーカーの対中依存に対する監視が強まっている。
